findings.text: 421 tables across 21 source/layer groups exist only in dev, with nothing in prod. Largest: CARL DWH (legacy gold) gold (150); Venus silver (80); FreeWheel bronze (79); usaffdwh silver (28); NEO bronze (12).
56 prod tables have exactly one retained snapshot older than 14 days, so no recurring load is evidenced. By source: iDeal (Oracle) (56).

29 stories are in Ready for Testing / In Testing / UAT / In Review with no matching table in the catalog (e.g. CARL-1382, CARL-1383, CARL-1384, CARL-1386, CARL-1389, CARL-1390). All were touched after the 2026-10-07 snapshot, so the tables may simply post-date the catalog export. Refresh the catalog before treating these as gaps.
18 Done stories were resolved after the catalog snapshot, so they cannot be judged until the catalog is refreshed.

8 stories are still open although a matching table is already in prod (7 of them Blocked: CARL-696, CARL-698, CARL-705, CARL-1469, CARL-1470, CARL-1472, CARL-2803). The ticket status is stale, or the table is live but unaccepted. Either way reporting on Jira status misstates the lake.

3 stories were Done before the catalog snapshot but no matching table exists: CARL-242, CARL-280, CARL-295. 2 of them have a near-identical table name in the catalog (likely a rename), so they are naming drift rather than missing data; the rest need an owner to confirm.
